summary: SABESP, a Brazilian water utility, filed a 6-K reporting shareholder approval of its merger of EMAE shares not already held. At an extraordinary meeting, SABESP shareholders approved the issuance of SABESP common shares to EMAE shareholders in exchange for their shares, per the June 29, 2026 protocol. The deal is conditioned on EMAE shareholder approval, postponed 30 days by CVM pending additional information. No financial terms, price per share, premium, or advisors were disclosed. The merger's completion depends on EMAE's vote; watch for regulatory clearance and exchange ratio details.
